description:
A community services manager has prepared a 6-slide presentation about their organization's annual community impact. All slide content (titles and bullets) is already complete, but the speaker notes are empty. Your task is to add specific speaker notes to each slide so a colleague can deliver the presentation.

The presentation is open in LibreOffice Impress. If not, open it from `~/Documents/Presentations/community_impact_report.odp`.

Add the following speaker notes to each slide:

**Slide 1 (Annual Community Impact Report 2024):**
"Welcome everyone to the 2024 Annual Community Impact Report presentation. Today we will review our key programs, volunteer engagement, financial performance, community outcomes, and our goals for the coming year."

**Slide 2 (Program Overview):**
"Our organization operated five core programs this year, serving over 3,200 participants across the metro area. The Youth Mentorship Program alone matched 450 at-risk youth with trained mentors, achieving a 92% retention rate."

**Slide 3 (Volunteer Engagement):**
"Volunteer engagement reached an all-time high this year. Our 1,850 registered volunteers contributed approximately 47,000 hours of service. This represents a 15% increase over last year and translates to an estimated $1.3 million in contributed value."

**Slide 4 (Financial Summary):**
"Total operating budget for 2024 was $2.8 million. Federal and state grants comprised 45% of funding, with individual donations at 30% and corporate partnerships at 25%. Administrative overhead was held to 11%, well below the industry benchmark of 15%."

**Slide 5 (Community Outcomes):**
"Community outcome data shows measurable improvement across all target indicators. Housing stability among program participants improved by 23%, employment rates increased by 18%, and food insecurity decreased by 31% compared to baseline measurements."

**Slide 6 (Goals for 2025):**
"Looking ahead to 2025, our strategic plan focuses on three primary goals: expanding the Youth Mentorship Program to two additional counties, launching a new workforce development initiative, and increasing our volunteer base by 20% through enhanced recruitment partnerships."

After adding all notes, save the file (Ctrl+S).
